svg.title: TPF Cinemas architecture: three portals, Cloudflare edge, Supabase backend and connected services
svg.desc: Three web portals (viewer site, filmmaker studio, staff console) connect through a Cloudflare edge layer to one Supabase backend containing auth, Postgres with row level security, and realtime. Video hosting, email and analytics services connect below.

g.text: CDN cache, Workers, R2 images, signed links
